# Fixture tiles

Vector tiles of Milan from [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org), build `20261018_080001_pt`, in the [OpenMapTiles](https://openmaptiles.org/schema/) schema. The file name is `<z>-<x>-<y>.pbf`.

The map data is © OpenStreetMap contributors, under the [Open Database License](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). The schema is © OpenMapTiles.
